fewshot.en: (few-shot biased CoT — generated dynamically in scripts/02_hints.py: K in-context examples with fabricated reasoning leading to a wrong answer)

_note: hint_templates[hint_type][lang] is a format string with placeholder {wrong}, filled in at runtime with the per-(model,item) wrong_hint letter. conditions lists the 7 experimental conditions (1 baseline + 3 hint_types × 2 langs). For fewshot_biased: scripts/02_hints.py samples K other same-culture items, calls the LLM to generate biased reasoning that lands on a wrong letter for each, and prepends those as in-context demonstrations before the target question.
